acceptance_rule: Pass if aggregate EV and sleeve PnL improve, EV and PnL improve in all three windows, max drawdown worsens by no more than 0.5 percentage points in any window, sleeve closed trades >= 40, and auxiliary earnings 8-K closed trades >= 10.
hypothesis: Inside the accepted SEC financial-report T+1 paper sleeve, earnings 8-K rows with auxiliary disclosure items beyond 2.02/9.01 may have a different event-quality profile than clean earnings 8-K rows, so they may deserve a separate paper-notional scalar.
